messages:
maria: FYI I brought up gemma-lite-v2 (converted from novaX) on int4 in staging. Quick smoke shows a ~7% drop in codebench pass@1 and some early-EOS / short-repeat behavior in generated completions. attaching eval summary shortly :disappointed_relieved:

triage-bot: conversion job completed: novaX -> gemma-lite-v2 (int4). Deployed to staging slot 's-42'.

pranav: :eyes: can you paste the eval diff or a snippet?

maria: pasted top lines from the eval run:
```
codebench pass@1: baseline 0.421 -> int4 0.391 (-7.1%)
mean BLEU: 23.4 -> 21.7
embedding cos-sim mean: 0.872 -> 0.861
note: more <EOS> tokens in generated sequences, shorter avg length
```

kai: hmm that smells like a Q/K or proj ordering mismatch during conversion, or per-head rotary scaling got folded wrong during head-splitting. both can shorten outputs by messing up attention distributions.

ashley: i ran a quick loader tweak locally — swapped Q/K projection order in the conversion loader (our novaX layout is Q,K,V, target is Q,V,K for the compiled kernel). After swapping, local int4 smoke looked back to baseline on codebench (small sample).

maria: can you show the exact change / command?

ashley: sure. run we used to repro locally:
```
# local smoke
python tools/convert_model.py --src novaX.pt --dst staging/gemma-lite-v2 --layout qkv --swap-qk --quant int4
python eval.py --model staging/gemma-lite-v2 --dataset codebench --batch 16 --quant int4
```
and the loader snippet we toggled:
```python
# loader.py (conversion)
if swap_qk:
    # novaX export had Q,K,V but compiled kernel expects Q,V,K ordering
    weights = np.stack([weights[0], weights[2], weights[1]], axis=0)
```

pranav: nice catch. also worth checking rotary scale per-head packing — if headwise scales were folded into a different contiguous layout it can be silently wrong with int4.

kai: +1. also verify padding token id and attention mask type (bool vs float) — we've hit short-output regressions from mask cast before.

maria: running the full rank-dist and embedding-sim tests now (kicking off job s-eval-907). will post results in a bit.

triage-bot: eval job s-eval-907 started: codebench full, embed-sim, rank-dist.

maria: results in — loader swap improved codebench pass@1 back to 0.428 (+6.4% vs int4 broken, near baseline). embedding cos-sim delta now -0.3% (was -1.2%). rank-dist distribution looks aligned in top-10. Looks like the Q/K reorder was the main culprit.

pranav: awesome. can we add a conversion unit test to catch this in future (compare attention head norms / top-k logits with fp16 baseline within tolerance)?

ashley: yep i'll add a small smoke that compares token-level logit deltas on a handful of canonical prompts and a toy long-context case. will open PR and link it here.

kai: note to onboarding doc: call out int4 proj-endianness and qkv layout caveats when converting novaX-like checkpoints -> gemma-style kernels. small paragraph + example command.

maria: moving this canary to 10% traffic for a few hours then full roll if stable. thanks everyone :tada:

triage-bot: canary rollout started: gemma-lite-v2-int4 -> 10% staging traffic.

maria: logging this thread under model-onboard/notes for the next onboarding sync.
